She once sang in Beethoven’s opera *Fidelio*, and the two became very good friends. Beethoven called her “Elise.” When Röckel was leaving the city of Vienna, Beethoven wrote “For Elise” to say goodbye to her. Another story is that Elise was Therese Malfatti. Beethoven was in love with her. He wrote a piece for her and put “For Therese” on the manuscript. Malfatti kept the manuscript and left it to her family when she died. Later, a man copied the manuscript and wrote “For Elise” by mistake. There is another possible Elise: Elise Barensfeld. She learned the piano from Malfatti, the same Malfatti in the second story. To help Malfatti, Beethoven wrote the piece for her to use to teach Barensfeld. These are just some guesses about who Elise was. We may never know the right answer. No one knew about the piece until 1867, when the manuscript was found. This was 40 years after Beethoven’s death, so he wasn’t around to tell us who Elise was. The study found that animal shaking begins with the head and ends with the tail. During a shake, the animal’s head, body and skin all move. The young fisherman said, “A hundred years ago, Urashima Taro went fishing at the sea, but he never came back. His mother was very sad, and she cried every day. Two months later, she passed away. Dear Mavis,
I’m sorry that I didn’t call you as soon as I arrived in New York City as you asked me to. The reason for that is I’ve been busy seeing the sights and having the time of my life. This is the first chance I’ve gotten to sit down and check my e-mails.
Anyway, it’s time that you catch up on what I’ve been up to since I checked in at my hotel on Monday. Yesterday, I got up early because I planned to walk across the Brooklyn Bridge, check out Wall Street, and then visit the 911 Memorial. When I got to the bridge, though, it was blocked off because a group of people were filming a movie. I moved closer to see if I knew anybody. You’re not going to believe this, but I saw my favorite actor, Tom Hanks, acting there. I tried to take a picture of him, but a guard stopped me before I could. He told me I could stay around and watch as long as I kept quiet and didn’t try that again. Though it was interesting, I decided to leave and finish what I set out to do. The day before that, I spent most of my time exploring Central Park and some of the museums around there. Also, on the first morning, I headed straight for the Empire State Building and then Times Square because I was dying to see them.
There’s too much to share in one e-mail, so I’ll tell you more next time. The city is calling my name, and I must not keep it waiting.
Your friend,
Stephanie

Meet the Goats That Help Create Firebreaks
　　Goats are great because they provide farmers with milk and meat. Now, Scott Morris of 805 Goats has found another way that goats can provide for us.
　　Morris lives in California. There is bush everywhere there, and the bush can easily catch fire and turn into a wildfire. So, to prepare for the autumn wildfire season, people have to clear the bush and build firebreaks. However, that takes a lot of time.
　　This is where Morris’s idea comes in. He gets his goats to do it. He knows goats love to eat, eat fast, and eat continuously. Also, getting goats to eat the bush is less expensive than having people clear it away. Besides, it’s good for the Earth.
　　Wildfires have become a serious problem not only in California but also in many other parts of the country. So, Morris’s 805 Goats and others like them might be just what we need to help fix the problem.

Jeff：Hi, you must be the new guy. I’m going to show you the ropes today.
Rick：Thanks! This is my first week working at BIG Supermarket.
Jeff：First, let’s start from the back. We put important groceries like eggs and milk there so that people will have to go through the whole store to get them. Perhaps they will pick up something on the way that they don’t plan to buy.
Rick：I never knew the trick!
Jeff：Another reason why the fridges are at the back of the store is it takes less time for the delivery trucks to stock them. We want to make sure they stay fresh the whole time.
Rick：I see your point.
Jeff：Next, you can see we put up nutritional information signs for some items. These not only make us a responsible store but also stand out and help customers choose which to buy. Sometimes, they can be helpful when it’s something we want to sell more.
Rick：Sounds very smart. Let me take some notes.
Jeff：At the end of the aisles, we put items that are on sale. These are usually products that people might not need or have on their grocery lists.
Rick：So when they see the good deals, they can’t help but put them in the cart! This is amazing!
Jeff：You’ve got it! Lastly, have you noticed where we put the small packages of things?
Rick：I know they are usually placed where people line up to pay, but is there also a reason behind it?
Jeff：Of course! After shopping in the store for some time, people get tired of making all the choices. So this is when they usually just pick up the chocolate, for example, without thinking it twice.
Rick：Wow, there’s so much about how customers think and do behind a simple act. Thanks for sharing with me!

But did you know that Mark Twain is not even his real name? It’s actually his pen name. There are many interesting facts about Mark Twain. Let’s take a look at a few.
Mark Twain was born on November 30, 1835, as Samuel Langhorne Clemens. He grew up in Missouri, the sixth of seven children. When he was born, a famous comet called Halley’s Comet had just passed by close to the sun. The comet is in an orbit and returns close to Earth about every 75 years.
Before he became a writer, he worked as a boat captain and a miner. He was an inventor, too. He invented a board game! The name by which he became most famous came from his days sailing on the Mississippi River. “Mark twain” means 12 feet of water to sailors.
The American writer was a big fan of science, and so was Nikola Tesla. The two became good friends. He also loved cats. Really loved them. He always said that cats were so much better than people that he’d rather live with them. He often rented cats to keep him company when he traveled and is known to have had 19 cats living with him at one time!
Also, Mark Twain predicted his own death. One year before Halley’s Comet was due to come back, he said “I came in with Halley’s Comet in 1835. It is coming again next year, and I expect to go out with it.” He died on April 21, 1910, one day after the comet had passed by.

Mark Twain was born on November 30, 1835, as Samuel Langhorne Clemens. He grew up in Missouri, the sixth of seven children. When he was born, a famous comet called Halley’s Comet had just passed by close to the sun. The comet is in an orbit and returns close to Earth about every 75 years.
Before he became a writer, he worked as a boat captain and a miner. He was an inventor, too. He invented a board game! The name by which he became most famous came from his days sailing on the Mississippi River. “Mark twain” means 12 feet of water to sailors.
The American writer was a big fan of science, and so was Nikola Tesla. The two became good friends. He also loved cats. Really loved them. He always said that cats were so much better than people that he’d rather live with them. He often rented cats to keep him company when he traveled and is known to have had 19 cats living with him at one time!
Also, Mark Twain predicted his own death. One year before Halley’s Comet was due to come back, he said “I came in with Halley’s Comet in 1835. It is coming again next year, and I expect to go out with it.” He died on April 21, 1910, one day after the comet had passed by.

There are many expressions, superstitions, and stories about the moon. One example of the first is “once in a blue moon,” which means when a second full moon appears in one month. Because a blue moon is not common, the expression shows something that almost never happens.
Superstitions play a big part in how people live their lives and how cultures take shape. Some people believe that if you point your finger at the moon, it will bring bad luck to you. Other people think that werewolves come out during full moons, and still other people think that a sick person should not look at the full moon because he or she may still be sick for a long time.
Just as important as superstitions are stories about the moon. When Europeans look at the moon, they see a man carrying heavy pieces of wood on his back there. In East Asia, the moon is home to the Jade Rabbit（玉兔）. It is said that the rabbit sacrificed itself so that an old man, who was really the Jade Emperor（玉皇大帝）in disguise, would not go hungry. To thank Jade Rabbit for what it did, the rabbit was sent to live on the moon for all time.
As you can see, the moon is more than just a moon to some people.

Jack：Oh, no. What happened?

Andy：Sleep… what?
Jack：Paralysis. It means you can’t move.
Andy：And this is… normal?
Jack：You’re 22, right?
Andy：Yeah, so?
Jack：That’s an age that many people experience it at.
Andy：So why does it happen?
Jack：Well, when we sleep, we experience Rapid Eye Movement, or REM. It’s called that because our eyes are moving quickly from side to side. It’s the part of the sleep cycle during which the brain is the most active, and so are our eyes.
Andy：Do our eyes really move around like that when we’re sleeping?
Jack：Yes, they do. Also, during this time, our muscles are “turned off” so we don’t try to walk during our sleep and hurt ourselves.
Andy：Wow, I didn’t know that.
Jack：So, usually when we wake up, it’s during the part we are not in REM anymore. But sometimes we wake up when we’re still in REM.
Andy：Oh! So we wake up and want to move, but our muscles are too “sleepy” to move yet!
Jack：That’s right! You got it!
Andy：But what about the monster I saw? It was so scary that I almost died!
Jack：Well, REM sleep is also the part where we have all our dreams.
Andy：So the body wakes up, but the brain is still dreaming?
Jack：Yup.
Andy：This is all very interesting, but also terrifying.
Jack：I can understand that. I’ve had it happen to me a few times, too.
Andy：Really? What did you do?
Jack：I just let it happen and didn’t try to fight it.

Headaches are bad, but migraines are even worse because the pain on one side or both sides of the head is stronger. And they may also make people feel sick. Worst of all, some people get them every now and then, and 6% of the people in the world experience them often.

However, people who get migraines can do some things to relieve the pain. The first is dealing with stress because migraines are often caused by too much stress. This can be done by cutting down on computer use, getting more and better rest, and doing activities that relax your body like yoga. The last can be done in a dark space that is free of noise because lights and sounds can make migraines worse. When your body doesn’t get enough water, it may also cause migraines, so it is best to drink a lot of it. What’s more, try not to stay out in the sun for too much time. If that’s not possible, then remember to give your body lots of water during the day and stay away from drinks like coffee, tea, and coke. Last but not least, massaging one’s temples with fingers that have been dipped in ice-cold water will take away some of the pain.

Today’s lesson is going to cover something I had no interest in until I started looking into it. Some people might already know a lot about it, and others may have heard something about it sometimes. Still, some of you may not know the word at all. What I’m talking about is the growing trend of cosplay.
Cosplay comes from the words costume and play. The people who take part in it love it, and so do the people who are around and looking at them.
People who cosplay dress up as their favorite characters from movies, video games, and comic books. Basically, they wear clothes, makeup, and other things to make themselves look like those characters. Some people are so into it that they walk, talk, and even act like those characters when they are in costume. If they are really good, they can even win big prizes at cosplay events around the world.
What started as a hobby has now become a big part of popular culture and the fashion world. We’ll see later on how the Internet brings cosplay to people everywhere.

Everyone loves watching movies. We enjoy them in movie theaters of all shapes and sizes as well as in our own comfortable homes. It’s also quite common for us to have yummy snacks like popcorn while we are watching the stories play out on our screens.
Not all movies are created the same, though. Some of them never make it to theaters even though they have wonderful stories. On the other hand, some of them are big hits at theaters even though their stories are nothing special. So, what is it that makes a movie successful? For the people that are in the movie business, the money that the movie makes at the box office is what makes it successful. They don’t look at the money that the movie brings in from its home videos, being shown on TV, or tie-in products because the sales information for those aren’t always easily gotten.
War movies, musicals, and historical dramas have long been the most popular kinds. However, those went out the window as soon as franchise movies came along in the 21st century. The kinds that have really won people’s hearts are the ones with superheroes from Marvel Comics. *The Star Wars*, *Harry* *Potter*, and *Jurassic* *Park* franchises also have lots of fans. Even so, if you adjust the box office sales for inflation, you’ll see that the old movies still stand up to what the modern world has given us.

Mothers play an important part in raising their children, and so do fathers. Even so, it’s the mothers that babies turn to when they are first born. After all, they lived inside their moms for nine months and will depend on their milk for the next few years to survive. Fathers simply aren’t able to do that.
When it comes to animals, the roles of mothers and fathers are sometimes switched. Take seahorses for example. The females put their eggs into pockets on the outside of the males’ bellies. The males then carry the eggs and take care of them until they are born. Similarly, emperor penguin fathers sit on the eggs to keep them warm. Also, some frog dads carry the eggs on their backs or in their vocal pockets. Those dads really know what it’s like to have a frog in their throat.
Human fathers help raise their kids, and animal dads do, too. With the mothers’ help, emperor penguin dads keep their babies warm on the ice and feed them food from their own stomachs. Wolf fathers play with their kids and teach them how to survive. They also feed and protect them. As you can see, there’s really nothing parents won’t do for their children.

Having a sense of humor is something most people think of as being uniquely human. No other living thing “gets” humor. It is so important to us that we can already understand it when we’re just babies. Humor allows us to laugh, and laughing helps build relationships and brings people together.
　　A sense of humor can bring joy, help us be smarter, healthier, and deal with difficult problems. It can also help us look at things from a different angle and even think outside the box. It can teach us to be playful and not take things so seriously. It can also teach us to laugh at ourselves. People who laugh a lot are not sad or sick very often, neither are those who laugh with them. When the mind is healthy, so is the body.
Children who have a sense of humor seem happier. Those who can appreciate and share humor are also often more sociable and usually have more friends. But most of all, humor can make life really fun. There’s nothing quite like laughing so hard that your stomach hurts or until tears are running down your face.
A sense of humor is not something we’re born with, though. It is something that we learn and grows with us. It also changes when we get older, much like we do. Things that we find funny as kids become too childish to make us laugh when we’re grown up. Babies, for example, don’t really understand humor yet. They just laugh when something we do is funny to them. As children get older, they turn to physical humor and doing funny things either to make themselves or others laugh.
Having a sense of humor is an important part of growing up, and it should be encouraged. Parents should show their kids early on that laughing is fun and that it should be done a lot. Make lots of jokes and tell funny stories. A family that laughs together has lots of fun together!

　　A sense of humor can bring joy, help us be smarter, healthier, and deal with difficult problems. It can also help us look at things from a different angle and even think outside the box. It can teach us to be playful and not take things so seriously. It can also teach us to laugh at ourselves. People who laugh a lot are not sad or sick very often, neither are those who laugh with them. When the mind is healthy, so is the body.
Children who have a sense of humor seem happier. Those who can appreciate and share humor are also often more sociable and usually have more friends. But most of all, humor can make life really fun. There’s nothing quite like laughing so hard that your stomach hurts or until tears are running down your face.
A sense of humor is not something we’re born with, though. It is something that we learn and grows with us. It also changes when we get older, much like we do. Things that we find funny as kids become too childish to make us laugh when we’re grown up. Babies, for example, don’t really understand humor yet. They just laugh when something we do is funny to them. As children get older, they turn to physical humor and doing funny things either to make themselves or others laugh.
Having a sense of humor is an important part of growing up, and it should be encouraged. Parents should show their kids early on that laughing is fun and that it should be done a lot. Make lots of jokes and tell funny stories. A family that laughs together has lots of fun together!

Fake news is on the rise, so it’s not surprising that it has made a lot of headlines recently. The stories are full of false information as well as information that leads people to think, believe, and do wrong things. They are seen by some to be funny and nothing terrible. However, they are seen by others to be powerful enough to cause change and cause people to take sides.
This leads to the question—what were Facebook, Twitter, and other Internet companies doing while fake news was being spread all over the Internet? What’s more, what were governments doing while big TV news stations were spreading fake news themselves? We know now that some action was taken. However, it wasn’t enough to stop people from getting confused about simple and easily checked facts.
As long as more isn’t done to stop the spread of fake news, the problem won’t go away. So, who is responsible for fighting fake news? Internet companies like Facebook believe that they are partly responsible for doing that. They have started using new tools that will help stop the quick spread of fake news. Even so, they still have a hard time staying ahead of people who try to cause problems. As soon as they block or take one down, another pops up to take its place. The Internet companies also believe that more should be done by governments to keep an eye on the information that the public can get their hands on.

Palm reading can give you some ideas about yourself. Before you do that, you need to know what the most important lines are and where they are on the palm.
First is the big line that begins at the side of the palm between the thumb and index finger and usually goes down to the wrist. It is called the life line, and it gives you an idea about your health and how long you might live.
Next is the line that starts at the same place as the life line and runs across the palm. It is called the head line, and its length tells how smart a person is. So, the longer it is, the smarter you are. Above that is the heart line. It runs across the palm to below the little finger at the edge of the hand. It shows how strong your heart is and how you feel about love.
After that is the line that runs from the bottom of the palm up to the bottom of the middle finger. It shows when and how you will become successful and is called the fate line.

Dear Editor,
I’m a big fan of your newspaper, and so are many of my friends. We enjoy all the information in your articles.
On Monday, you ran one about some of the best and worst paying jobs in the USA. However, I was surprised it didn’t talk about the pay gap. Men get paid a lot for work, and women should, too. It’s too bad that they don’t.
Women make up almost half of the workforce. Sadly, women with full-time jobs in the USA only get 79 cents for every dollar men make. Because of that, women earn US$10,763 less than men every year. Women with university degrees face a higher pay gap, and so do women of color. In fact, they have it worse. African American women aren’t paid that much, and neither are Latin American women. The first gets 60 cents for every dollar paid to white men, and the second gets 55 cents. The truth is working women would make enough money for about 83 more weeks of food for their families if they were paid the same as men.
This pay gap hurts women, their families, and businesses. More has to be done to stop it.
Sincerely,
Ruth Bader

For those that haven’t, eSports is short for electronic sports, and they are competitions that use video games instead of traditional ball games. These kinds of competitions have been around since the late 1970s.
At the start, how to be a good player was decided by how many points he or she was able to get during play, and the best players were the ones with the highest scores. As soon as the style of game play changed to fighting games, the way of deciding the winners also changed. The best players were the ones who beat or killed their opponents. It didn’t matter if the games were one-on-one, two-on-two, or more.
eSports became really popular as soon as the Internet grew in size and speed. The place which experienced that the most was South Korea. There, video games were more than something fun and interesting that was played to pass the time. They became real sports for the body and the mind, and people could actually make money while they were playing them. South Koreans couldn’t get enough of eSports, and they were even shown on TV all day and all night long. Soon, eSports were catching on in China and other parts of Asia. Now, they are becoming just as big in the USA and Europe, and some eSports players are taking home as much money as some traditional sports players. As long as there are video games, there will be eSports.

It may not be difficult to find a large number of vending machines in your life. You can find vending machines on your way home, at school, in the department stores, in the hospitals, or even on the top of the mountains. Inside the machines are drinks, chocolate, potato chips, comic books, and even cellphones. The reason why we can see vending machines almost everywhere is that they are quite convenient, and that they help people cut down on the cost of buying products.
Vending machines are not special today, but it may be surprising for you to see a human-powered vending machine. Since it’s so convenient for people to get food from vending machines, whether healthy or unhealthy, the problem of overweight has become serious around the world. However, it’s quite difficult to expect customers to choose bananas or vegetables over chocolate or potato chips, so Pep Torres came up with a better idea to deal with the problem.
Pep Torres attached a fixed bicycle to a vending machine, which sells coke and chocolate, so a customer who wants the product inside the vending machine would have to ride the bicycle for a certain distance to get it. He has high hopes for the machine. “We’d like to see it in train stations and schools,” he says. “That way, people can eat their potato chips and still get in shape.” Next time you see a vending machine with a fixed bicycle on the sidewalks, just get on the bike to get what you want to eat and don’t worry about putting on weight.

Barbara：Hey, everyone! Listen to these new wordplay jokes.
Jean：You have new ones?
Luke：This is going to be good.
Barbara：What animal is always at a baseball game?
Jean：What?
Barbara：A bat!
Luke：Oh! I see what you did there! Baseball “bat”!
Jean：That was terrible, but good use of a homographic pun.
Luke：Yes, still very funny!
Barbara：Ok, I have another one. What kind of tree fits in your hand?
Jean：That one is too easy. The answer is a “palm” tree.
Luke：Because of the palm of your hand, right?
Barbara：Yup! Why did the student eat his homework?
Jean：Why?
Barbara：Because his teacher said it was a piece of cake!
Jean：Ha, ha! Okay, that one was too funny not to laugh at.
Luke：I’m laughing just trying to imagine a student eating his homework!
Barbara：Why is the number 6 afraid of the number 7?
Jean：I don’t know.
Luke：I do! It’s because 7, 8, 9! It’s a homophonic pun!
Barbara：Bingo. I told my parents the joke last night. My mom didn’t know that one, and neither did my dad.
Jean：Oh! I get it! The 8 sounds like “ate.” So, 7 ate 9!
Luke：Here’s a different one. What is a monster’s favorite dessert?
Jean：Really? Everyone knows that one!
Barbara：It’s “I scream”! That’s an oronym!
Luke：Ha, ha! Yes! Because it sounds like “ice cream”! Isn’t it funny?
Barbara：That joke was so bad that only you laughed at it.
Luke：I don’t care. I enjoyed it!
Jean：All right, I have one, too. What place on Earth never has anything fun to do?
Barbara：Oh! A new joke! I don’t know this one!
Luke：Barbara hasn’t heard it before, and neither have I.
Jean：BOREneo! Get it? From the island of Borneo? It’s a phonetic joke!
(Barbara and Luke just shake their heads)
